subject: zoology
question_text: Write four salient features of cyclostomes.

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.55, VSAQ 108). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. TEXT BEYOND THE BOOK: the book prints five features and no example; Petromyzon and Myxine are added from the standard syllabus list.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Jawless body
steps.margin_note: Four numbered features, two in this step. One short line each.
lines: 2) The body is long, slender and eel like, and
steps.why: Cyclostomes are placed apart from all other fishes because they have no jaws, so the first two features name what they lack rather than what they have.
common_mistakes: Calling cyclostomes true fishes. They are jawless vertebrates and are kept in a separate class.
Writing that they have scales. The body is naked.
steps.memory_tip: Cyclo means circle: a round mouth and no jaws is the whole group in two words.

steps.label: Mouth and heart
steps.margin_note: Give the two remaining features, then one example. Four features are enough for two marks.
lines: 3) The mouth is round and suctorial. It has no
jaws, so the animal clings to a host fish and
steps.why: The round sucking mouth and the horny teeth on the tongue are what let a jawless animal still feed, so these two features always travel together.
common_mistakes: Writing that the horny teeth are on the jaws. There are no jaws; the teeth sit on the tongue.
Saying the mouth bites. It is suctorial, so it sucks and rasps.
steps.memory_tip: No jaws, so the mouth is a round sucker and the teeth ride on the tongue.

insider_note: Write the word jawless in the first line — it is the one word that separates cyclostomes from every other fish, and most part marks turn on it.
